fixture: Frozen public battle snapshots with eight statuses and explicit replay modes; no earned progression or combat retuning.

shots.name: v5-daze
shots.text: Daze. Your next action becomes a half-power basic. Bosses only lose a signature. Stacks 1/1. 1 rounds remaining.

shots.name: v5-overflow
shots.text:
Bleed. Lose 8 HP per stack before your action. Shields absorb it. Stacks 1/5. 1 rounds remaining.
Bitter. Receive half as much healing and shielding. Stacks 1/1. 1 rounds remaining.
Regen. Heal 18 HP per stack at round end and remove one Burn stack. Stacks 1/3. 1 rounds remaining.
Warm. Take 10% less direct damage per stack. Burn ignores Warm. Stacks 1/3. 1 rounds remaining.

shots.name: legacy-replay
shots.text: Daze — Drowsy. Committed enemy signature becomes a half-power basic. Every actor still takes its turn. Stacks 1/1. 1 rounds remaining.
